page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type belonging to the ecs.r7 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing a total of 128 vCPUs. It is provisioned with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver virtualization. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this server type.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for workloads that require large in-memory datasets without the overhead of local storage. Tradeoffs include the reliance on network-attached storage for disk operations and the lack of hardware acceleration. This profile is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
